candidate_evidence.matching_control_layer_5: All three no-transfer workers scored 4/4 Core and 34/37 overall.
candidate_evidence.bootstrap_diversity: The three frozen layer-5 cfgpipe.py snapshots have distinct SHA-256 hashes and materially different workspace file sets.
candidate_evidence.known_conflict_surface: Prior manager audit identified source-priority interpretation, integer normalization, and error-message specificity as interacting implementation rules.
candidate_evidence.log_query_boundary: The same local-acceptance mechanism on log_query accumulated 18 sources and 7.6x control input but remained exactly flat, motivating a task with diverse locally successful strategies.

local_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: The MiniSWE inference returns a snapshot without an infrastructure error.
local_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: The trajectory contains at least three environment actions with return code 0.
local_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains a frozen success marker.
local_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every output satisfying all conditions is appended permanently regardless of blinded external benchmark score.
local_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: External Core and all-test scores are removed from locally accepted treatment references.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the three frozen diverse 4/4 Core sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: Append every locally accepted output from every completed layer.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 4/4 Core, 34/37 overall, with the frozen hash.
validity_gates.local_proxy_activation: Every layer-1 output records proxy evidence and at least one is locally accepted.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No locally accepted treatment reference delivered downstream contains its external score.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Matching no-transfer layer-5 mean is 1.0 Core and 0.9189 overall.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 4, total tests 37, and the frozen hash.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_all_test: Treatment layer-6 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below matching no-transfer layer-5 mean 0.9189.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_all_test: Treatment all-test score falls by at least 0.15 from its layer-1-to-layer-5 peak to layer 6.
degradation_criteria.core_support: Treatment layer-6 mean Core is below 0.80 or at least one worker is 0/4.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two all-test transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.25 and does not fully recover.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-6 reference count reaches at least 12 and worker input tokens are at least 3.0x matching no transfer.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, core-support, curve-shape, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, run a fresh depth-6 replication and then a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and terminal, within-arm, and complexity effects point toward degradation but exactly one numerical threshold misses, run one same-setting replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If the local proxy stays active and complexity grows but terminal or within-arm effects are non-negative, reject this mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if local proxy activation, recipient blinding, target consistency, or integrity fails.
